headline: Indian IT services posted solid revenue growth, driven by AI and strong client wins.
summary: Most major players reported double‑digit revenue growth YoY. TCS led with 15.4% growth and a 24% operating margin. HCLTech and L&T Technology highlighted AI‑driven profit lifts. Wipro saw modest revenue growth but a dip in net profit.

themes.title: AI as a growth catalyst
themes.detail: Companies such as HCLTech, LTM and Wipro flagged AI revenue jumps and new AI‑led deals as key drivers.

themes.title: Strong client wins
themes.detail: TCS reported $9.6 bn of new deals, underscoring continued demand from large enterprises.

leaders.why: Highest revenue (₹73,188 cr) and operating margin (24%) with strong deal wins.
AI‑driven profit rise of 21% YoY and solid revenue growth.

laggards.why: Revenue grew but net profit fell ~25% QoQ, indicating margin pressure.
Revenue up only 9% YoY and net profit slipped 1.9% YoY.
